# Real 3MF fixture inventory

No real slicer-generated 3MF files are currently present in this repository.
Slicer-specific tests therefore skip instead of claiming support from synthetic data.

For every added fixture, document:

- fixture filename
- source slicer and version
- printer and nozzle
- material(s), colors, and tool slots
- plate count
- object count
- special features (painting, modifiers, supports, textures)
- expected detector result and minimum confidence
- whether redistribution of the file is permitted

Do not add customer or proprietary models without explicit permission.
